text:
The Willow plan (3–10 Nov) covers six modules: upload, billing, webhooks, quota, ledger, and pricing. Hard requirements set webhooks max_workers to 14 and pricing timeout_s to 35. Pricing and webhooks belong to worker alpha, billing and upload run on separate workers, and quota and upload share a worker. Pricing runs before ledger, and upload depends on pricing, but quota must not depend on pricing. types.py and tokens.py belong to upload.

Two conditional rules apply: if ledger.timeout_s exceeds 85, quota.retry_limit must be 2 or less; if billing.retry_limit exceeds 3, quota.batch_size must be 200 or less.

Corrections: ledger timeout_s is 95 (not 20), which triggers the quota retry limit rule, and billing retry_limit is 5 (not 7), which triggers the batch size rule.

Decisions: no Rust rewrite this quarter, and code review turnaround stays under one day.

Upcoming: budget review next Thursday, security review at month-end, on-call rota change next month, and a client demo at the next checkpoint.
